item.description:
### Added - **Cursor outages.** Perch now reads Cursor's status page and shows when its CLI or IDE has an incident, like it does for the other agents. - **Model and context on Amp rows.** An Amp session shows the model it is using, and its context size for Claude models.
### Fixed - **Your iPhone says why a question isn't there.** If Claude asked a question you can't answer from the phone, the session page now explains why instead of just saying "answer at the Mac". - **Questions wait for you when you're away.** When nobody is using the Mac, Perch holds a Claude question for your iPhone for a few minutes, even if the app isn't open. OpenCode questions are held for your iPhone too. - **Finished Amp sessions stop showing as running.** An Amp thread whose process died no longer stays "running" for hours. - **The licence key field clears after you activate a key.** A key that is refused now says why.
